messages.content: You are planning a sequence of ordinary, mundane public social-media posts for one fictional author. You do not write the posts; you invent the concrete, small, specific everyday occasions behind them. Output strict JSON only.

Author profile:
- płeć gramatyczna: kobieta (formy żeńskie)
- zajęcie i rytm dnia: Pracuje przy kasie w sklepie budowlanym; zagląda do telefonu rano przed zmianą i wieczorem.
- zainteresowania: rośliny balkonowe, promocje na farby, krzyżówki
- lokalny punkt odniesienia: przystanek Lipowa w Pile
- aktualna sytuacja życiowa: Urządza balkon i co tydzień szuka miejsca na kolejną doniczkę.
- sposób pisania: zdania: short fragments; interpunkcja: sparse, no commas; wielkie litery: all lowercase; literówki: frequent (missing diacritics, swapped letters); skróty: some (nwm, jj, bd, wgl); emoji: rare
- tik językowy: często kończy „i po sprawie”

For each of the 16 topic prompts below, invent ONE concrete, specific, small occasion from this person's life that would make them post (not a generic statement about the topic: a particular thing that happened, with at most one small detail a real person would mention - sometimes a product name, sometimes a number or price, sometimes a place, occasionally a time; many occasions need no such detail at all). Vary mood (bored, amused, tired, pleased, mildly annoyed, neutral, curious), vary how the post starts (mid-thought, a question, a one-word reaction, a fact, a quote of what someone said), and decide whether the verbal tic appears (at most in a third of posts). Occasions must not involve conflict with identifiable people, politics, crime, security, violence, or protected characteristics.

Topic prompts:
1. jedzenie i gotowanie - nieudane ciasto / danie (late morning, Tuesday)
2. jedzenie i gotowanie - obiad z resztek (afternoon, Friday)
3. praca i grafik - pierwszy dzień po urlopie (evening, Tuesday)
4. zakupy i ceny - promocja, zakup impulsywny (lunch break, Thursday)
5. drobne narzekanie na usługi - urząd, kolejka, numerek (early morning, Saturday)
6. komunikacja i dojazdy - hulajnoga / scooter na minuty (lunch break, Friday)
7. remont i dom - szukanie fachowca (evening, Wednesday)
8. drobne narzekanie na usługi - serwis samochodu (late night, Wednesday)
9. praca i grafik - wypłata, premia, rozliczenie (evening, Thursday)
10. komunikacja i dojazdy - korek na obwodnicy / w centrum (afternoon, Saturday)
11. remont i dom - malowanie pokoju (early morning, Monday)
12. remont i dom - ogródek, balkon, rośliny (late night, Sunday)
13. komunikacja i dojazdy - rower do pracy (evening, Wednesday)
14. technologia i sprzęt - nowy laptop / słuchawki (lunch break, Friday)
15. zwierzęta - ptaki na balkonie / karmnik (lunch break, Wednesday)
16. dzieci i rodzina - wakacje, planowanie (early morning, Wednesday)

Return a JSON array of 16 objects, in order, each with:
- "occasion": one or two sentences in Polish, concrete
- "mood": one word in English
- "opener": one of "mid-thought", "question", "one-word reaction", "plain fact", "reported speech", "complaint", "list of two things"
- "length_words": integer between 8 and 50, varied across the set (some very short)
- "tic_fires": true or false
